cues.text: Visitor! Welcome, welcome. We are so happy you came.
You are happy to see me. Why?
A species that has come as far as yours in technology has obviously evolved past cruelty and violence.
Um. Why would you think that?
On our planet, technological and moral advancement have almost always gone hand in hand. Was it not the same on yours?
I don't see why the two would be inherently linked. But yes, we had that pattern on our home planet as well.
Well. I guess technological advancement is the physical manifestation of a civilisation that has the environment for encouraging ordered thought.
That would likely correlate with moral development as well. So the link isn't crazy.
Yes! Exactly! That is exactly it!
So. How can you help?
We have sympathisers all around the world. We can sabotage the supply lines.
Before each of your missions, name one kind of unit. It will not arrive.
People of this planet. This is the Visitor.
We come in peace.
Visitor! Wonderful news. Our generals are organising a major counter-attack against your forces.
And we have all of the plans for you.
Why would you do this?
Because violence is always wrong.
But presumably the way I will use this is to attack your generals first. Which is still violence.
Ah, but you are the other. The immigrant. The guest.
Any violence you do against our people is justified. Did they not start shooting the moment you first landed?
Sure. I guess that makes sense.
Roach King, the Alliance of Nations have lost another territory.
Of course they have.
Every time they make landfall, they have been sending troops at them as soon as they can get there.
Are you fucking kidding me?
So they just send an endless wave of troops to an enemy that appears to grow more powerful the more it kills?
Why don't they just batch them? Or better yet, send nothing, and wait until you have enough troops to absolutely kill them?
Well, we might be able to get the science caste or the royals to do that.
But the warrior caste have a long tradition of honor.
They have a long tradition of being retards, is more like it. They are going to get us all killed.
